Holy Paladin Healing Gear and Best in Slot — 12.1

OverallMythic+Raid

This list contains the highest HPS setup from all sources for Holy Paladin. Keep in mind that there are many other setups that perform within the margin of error. This list is not the end-all-be-all list where any item that is not listed is far behind this specific selection.

This list is by no means a replacement for QuestionablyEpic. Depending on your previous Great Vault choices and the gear you have available, your BiS gear might look different in some spots than the below list.

FAQWhich Tier Set Pieces Do I Want?
In Midnight Season 2, you are able to convert any item to a tier piece and it'll keep its original stats and effects! This means that your offpiece no longer matters as much. Reckless Spirit Breastplate and Chausses of Unbound Rancor will always be desired due to their higher item levels, but your other 2 remaining tier slots can change depending on what gear you have available.
  • Helm: Skullguard of the Risen Sacrifice from Nek'zali the Soulcoiler
  • Shoulders: Cinderfury Shoulderguards from Murder Row
  • Chest: Reckless Spirit Breastplate from The Coiled Altar
  • Gloves: Gauntlets of the Consecrated Flame from Entombed Sentinels
  • Legs: Chausses of Unbound Rancor from Ula'tek
FAQWhat to Get From The Great Vault?

With Nebulous Voidcore being able to be taken from the Great Vault instead of an item, you will prioritize getting these bonus rolls with your first vault. This will allow you to roll for an item on any dungeon or boss and receive a 1/6 Myth track version of the item. Because Ula'tek drops us Myth track Chausses of Unbound Rancor from Heroic, you will prioritize the bonus rolls to get this BiS item well before you have a chance to kill the boss on Mythic. By bonus rolling the boss you can also get access to Aqirbane Reliquary. Keep in mind that dropped items from Mythic will be at 9/6 Mythic though, whereas bonus-rolled items cap out at 6/6.

FAQWhich Tier Set Pieces Do I Want?
In Midnight Season 2, you are able to convert any item to a tier piece and it'll keep its original stats and effects! This means that your offpiece no longer matters as much. Reckless Spirit Breastplate and Chausses of Unbound Rancor from the new raid are highely desirable due to their higher item levels and unique effect. If you cannot obtain those items you will want to prioritize a combination of 4 from the list below. Pants are your least desirable slot.
  • Helm: Greathelm of Temptation from Murder Row
  • Shoulders: Cinderfury Shoulderguards from Murder Row
  • Chest: Breastplate of Soaring Terror from Ruby Life Pools
  • Gloves: Thornspike Gauntlets from The Blinding Vale
  • Legs: Ancient General's Obsidian Pillars from Altar of Fangs
TipsWhich Dungeons Should I Farm?
If you have limited time to play the game, we recommend to farm the following dungeons:
  • Blinding Vale: Drops a shield: Teldrassil's Sacrifice and one of the best dungeon trinkets: Lightspire Core.
  • Murder Row: Drops one of the best trinkets: Freightrunner's Flask as well as bracers and a neck.
  • King's Rest: Drops multiple good items but nothing outstanding.

TipsWhich Raid-Items Do I Want Most?
If you need to submit a list of highly-important items to your raidleader, or simply want to focus on the most important bosses and items, we got you covered!
  • Chausses of Unbound Rancor: Cantrip leg item that you will catalyze. Drops from Ula'tek.
  • Aqirbane Reliquary: Another cantrip item that drops from Ula'tek.
  • Soulcoiler Ritual Vessel: incredibly powerful trinket that drops from Nek'zali the Soulcoiler.
  • Gebbo's Bottomless Bag: Second best trinket. Drops from The Lost Explorers.
